projects.title: Notion-Based Administrative Workspace & Correspondence Management

details.role: Head of Administrative Bureau / Workspace Architect
details.challenge: Official letters, archives, and 300+ organizational records were stored across fragmented channels without a centralized relational database, creating delays in tracking proposals and LPJ submissions across 15+ programs.
details.solution: Architected an integrated Notion workspace with real-time correspondence databases, standardized verification status tags, and unified LPJ report templates.
impact: Supervised 9 bureau members with zero document misplacement or data loss
Reduced file audit and archive retrieval turnaround time by 70%
Ensured seamless administrative execution for 15+ student association work programs

projects.title: Hasa Wear — Local E-Commerce Website Implementation

impact: Successfully deployed responsive product catalog with 100% functional checkout
Generated automated digital order receipts and simulated localized shipping fee structures
Demonstrated solid operational understanding of commercial technology infrastructure
